text.en:
Deals 30% more damage than other High Impact Machine Guns.

Scoring hits grant 10% Healing Charge. Unlike Support-Frame Auto Rifles, this is the only way to gain charge.

Hip-fire to shoot Healing Rounds at 600 RPM that seek allies within the reticle. Healing Rounds do not consume ammo, instead taking 2% Healing Charge each, and restore 30 HP per hit. Landing a healing round <title refills [G_refills] /> 2 ammo into the magazine.

Landing 6 healing rounds within 1 second of each other spawns a <strand/>Threadling at the ally's location, and grants both you and them the 'Support Frame Boost'. Support Frame Boost increases Weapon Damage by 10% for 6 seconds and stacks with everything.

Healing a Teeming Nest also grants you the Support Frame Boost.
